limitation: Approximate wall time subtracting recorded SIGSTOP intervals; includes scheduling and I/O. Resume timestamp recorded shortly after signal. Not CPU time.

storage.method: Visible files plus positive unexplained filesystem free-space delta and a conservative handoff reserve. Limits refresh only from the explicit user-approval record. Concurrent disk activity can overestimate unlinked SQLite scratch; this is not exact process-attributed disk usage.

memory.memoryMethod: Observed parent peak plus largest sequential worker peak is a conservative process-tree upper bound, not an exact simultaneous RSS measurement.
